Grizzlies 126Warriors 98

Wells and Coward lead a fifth straight win

Final · Thu, Nov 19 · Memphis

Memphis beat Golden State 126–98, a 28-point home win. The Grizzlies move to 12–4; the Warriors fall to 8–8.
